# dsh-group-tab — Workgroup
A right-sidebar tab for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that shows **who is working right now, what each agen
t is doing, and how long the rest will probably take** — as a live group chat, not a static log.
*Live: members, their current tool, per-member ETA, and who is waiting on you — recording of the rea
members, their current tool, per-member ETA, and who is waiting on you — recording of the real tab.*
Registered as a tab of dsh-better-sidebar (the sidebar plugin that exposes the tab registry other pl
ugins register into).
## Why
When a main agent delegates to three subagents and starts two background jobs, DSH's conversation vi
ew tells you about one of them. You end up opening four sessions to answer "is anything stuck?".
This tab answers it in one place:
- one card per member (main agent + every subagent in the tree), with the tool it is running right n

ow
- a per-member ETA, from **this machine's own** finished runs (median of the last 20), clearly la

belled when no history exists yet
- background jobs folded onto the member that owns them
- a merged

timeline: started / tool switch / message / job progress / finished — newest at the bottom
- the mo

del each member is dispatching on (`provider / model`)
- members waiting on **you** (a question or a
n approval) are pinned to the top with a red badge, a header count, and an optional chime when a sub
e pinned to the top with a red badge, a header count, and an optional chime when a subagent finishes
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then this plugin, either from npm (once published) or straight from GitHub:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then open the right sidebar and pick **Workgroup** from the `＋` menu (it sits next to Tasks). It ope
ns itself once per page load for the active session, and once per session as soon as delegated work
starts; close it and it stops doing that for the rest of the page.
## How it reads data
| Source | Transport | What it gives |
| `sessions` client service | subscription (event-driven) | who exists, who is running, titles, line

age |
| `jobs` client service | subscription (event-driven) | background task rosters per session |
| `POST /sidebar/api/subagents.live` | poll, **only while something runs** | current tool + latest t

ext per member |
| `POST /sidebar/api/git.models` | one call per member, 30 s cache | the model rout
e a member is using |
**Idle costs nothing.** The 2 s fold poll and the 1 s clock tick only exist while at least one membe
r or job is running, and they stop when the page is hidden (`visibilitychange`). An idle panel issue
s zero requests; a member starting to run flips the session list, which wakes the poll back up. The
footer says `LIVE · 2s` while working and `LIVE · idle, no polling` when not.
## Notes
- **No host half, no files.** The plugin owns no route and no markdown file; the panel is derived fr

om live events, so it can never show stale state.
- **No markdown file** is written per turn; the ti
meline lives in memory (200 entries) and per-member start times in `localStorage` so a page refresh

does not restart the clock.
- The chime is Web Audio (no asset), and the bell button in the header m

utes it.
- The UI is Chinese or English from the browser language (`zh*` → Chinese, everything else
The UI is Chinese or English from the browser language (`zh*` → Chinese, everything else → English).

ata, then asserts the rendered text: roster, ETA, model route, timeline diffing, awaiting pinning, a
nd that an idle panel stops polling. `test/i18n-check.mjs` asserts the English dictionary is picked
that an idle panel stops polling. `test/i18n-check.mjs` asserts the English dictionary is picked up.
## Publishing checklist

- [ ] add `repository` / `homepage` to `package.json`
- [ ] `npm publish` (the package is already pu

blic-ready: no `private`, `files` list, MIT)
- [ ] tag a release and keep `preview/*.png` in sync
